headline.text: L3 ML4 mold washer failed visual — *screws found inside* equipment during 3rd shift cleaning verification, re-cleaned and passed.

summary: One foreign material flag resolved: screws found inside L3 ML4 mold washer, cleaned and cleared by shift end. Six sanitation re-clean requests across L1 and L2 — all resolved same shift. L3 traceability gap: twist wrap pallet received with mixed expiration dates from L1.

food_safety.title: Screws found inside ML4 mold washer during cleaning
food_safety.summary: Janeth Sanchez found screws inside mold washer equipment during 3rd shift cleaning verification at 04:32 MT — visual inspection failed, equipment re-cleaned, passed ATP and visual by 05:03 MT.
food_safety.status: Resolved — mold washer re-cleaned and passed visual inspection and ATP test.

quality.title: Twist wrap pallet received with mixed expiration dates
quality.summary: Nathan Gevenois flagged inbound pallet from L1 with mixed Best By dates — cannot identify when day codes changed except by rough quantity estimate, traceability compromised for this product.
quality.status: Open — Nathan requested L1 contact to prevent future mixed-date pallets for traceability.

sanitation.title: S4 depositor D1 required second caustic cycle
sanitation.summary: Kitchen tablet reported D1 depositor failed first caustic clean cycle at 23:00 MT, required second cycle to pass — recorded as 'no clean' on first attempt.
sanitation.status: Resolved — second caustic cycle completed, no carryover to Level 2 paperwork initially but Charity Young requested documentation.

sanitation.title: S1 Top Matrix floor flagged for re-clean
sanitation.summary: Ebrima Dibba reported Top Matrix floor needs re-cleaning during 1st shift QA walkthrough at 06:48 MT — sanitation dispatched operator to address.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Joseph Scott confirmed operator dispatched, area cleared.

sanitation.title: S1 metal detector belt flagged for re-clean
sanitation.summary: Chris Featherstone reported metal detector belt still needs cleaning during 1st shift QA walkthrough at 06:50 MT — sanitation dispatched operator to address.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Joseph Scott confirmed operator dispatched, area cleared.

sanitation.title: S1 Tunnels 1 & 2 flagged for re-clean
sanitation.summary: Ebrima Dibba reported Tunnels 1 and 2 need re-cleaning during 1st shift QA walkthrough at 07:05 MT — third re-clean flag on S1 same walkthrough.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Joseph Scott posted photos confirming areas cleared by 07:50 MT.

sanitation.title: Peppermint residue found in ML3 ingredients tank center
sanitation.summary: Victor Mejia and Marlenis Fernandez found peppermint in center of ingredients tank during 3rd shift inspection at 22:21 MT — visual inspection failed.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Zack Kurtz clarified this was ingredients tank, cleaning addressed.

sanitation.title: ML1 C6 conveyor belt failed visual — dirty roller
sanitation.summary: Janeth Sanchez reported C6 belt failed visual inspection at 22:52 MT — roller found dirty because line was not disassembled for full roller cleaning during Level 2 clean, later passed ATP after adjustment.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Angel Cabrera noted rollers not fully disassembled; belt cleared and passed ATP by 23:43 MT.

opportunities.text: Review S1 Level 2 cleaning verification sequence — based on three separate re-clean flags (metal detector belt, matrix floor, tunnels) during same QA walkthrough suggesting first-pass effectiveness gap.
Consider packaging traceability controls for twist wrap palletizing — based on L3 receiving mixed Best By dates on inbound pallet where day code transitions cannot be identified.
Consider visual inspection protocol for ingredient tank interiors after product changeovers — based on peppermint residue found in ML3 tank center during 3rd shift inspection.
Consider adding mold washer interior inspection to ML4 post-cleaning checklist — based on screws found inside equipment during today's 3rd shift cleaning verification.
Review conveyor roller disassembly requirements in ML1 Level 2 cleaning SOPs — based on C6 dirty roller flag where Angel Cabrera noted rollers weren't fully freed from chocolate residue.
